subject.title: feat(ui): scroll truncated sidebar session names on hover

question: After the row-reuse bug is fixed, should OpenClaw accept automatic hover scrolling for truncated Control UI sidebar session names?
rationale: The PR adds a new user-facing hover animation and has the protected maintainer label, so code correctness does not settle the interaction choice.

options.title: Accept after row-reuse fix
options.body: Merge the focused hover-marquee behavior after sidebar row identity/state is made safe and exact-head checks stay clean.

options.title: Keep static ellipsis
options.body: Decline the feature if maintainers prefer the current static label plus native title tooltip behavior.

options.title: Request another affordance
options.body: Ask for a tooltip, popover, or broader sidebar-title design if automatic scrolling is not the desired interaction.

recommendation.title: Accept after row-reuse fix
recommendation.body: Merge the focused hover-marquee behavior after sidebar row identity/state is made safe and exact-head checks stay clean.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent Control UI history and is the best available owner for the protected hover-interaction product choice.
